mini_ab.design: 6 queries, cold cache per query per arm (separate SC_DATA_DIR), rerank OFF vs ON, known-answer keyword check in top-1/top-3

mini_ab.interpretation: no ranking change on this easy known-answer set — lexical fusion already places the correct answer top-1, so the cross-encoder has nothing to fix; rerank adds ~280ms p50 (271-352ms per journal) at pool 3-5
mini_ab.honest_limitations: (1) the question set cannot differentiate reranker quality — a discriminating benchmark needs hard word-overlap distractor queries with human relevance labels, still open; (2) one keyword-check artifact: the 'java javascript difference' query was scored miss because the literal 'different' is not a substring of 'difference', while the ON-arm top-1 title 'What's the difference between JavaScript and Java?' is by inspection the correct answer; (3) engines serving results: keenable + wikipedia lanes only (DDG 202 soft-block / Mojeek timeout / Yahoo 500 re-confirmed this round, consistent with G2-PROTOCOL-NOTES)
mini_ab.not_claimed: this is not a public-SERP relevance certification, not a quality improvement claim, and not a Windows-host acceptance
